scope: Descriptive public live evidence only. Never used for arm selection, canonical scoring/recovery, prompts, thresholds or answer keys.

window_rules.request_membership: start <= t_sched < end; final persisted public requests only
window_rules.empty_or_reversed: Zero rows and inconclusive; do not substitute another window.

metric_rules.N_and_offered: Count persisted request outcomes in the window; do not infer unpersisted arrivals.
metric_rules.error_rate: failed/admitted if admitted>0, else0 (source convention; counts disclosed)
metric_rules.p95_latency_s: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*.95 over successful latency_s only; measured from scheduled arrival, including queueing.
metric_rules.latency_error_target_met: N>0, ok>0, p95<=existing slo.p95_latency_s, error_rate<=existing slo.max_error_rate; empty window is null.
metric_rules.full_configured_target_met: latency_error_target_met plus shed_rate<=existing slo.max_shed_rate; no new threshold.

interpretation_rules: No action/change, missing canonical verification, failed/partial evidence: inconclusive.
Pre-onset trigger, action start or action completion: report explicitly; do not claim restoration.
Both pre and post latency/error targets met: restoration not demonstrated.
Pre miss/post meet: temporal improvement only, not causal proof.
Canonical recovered ignores shed cap; retain unchanged alongside descriptive full configured target.

canonical_disclosures.fault_window_before_action: onset through action completion; includes API/action/restart time
canonical_disclosures.after_action: action completion through live duration; may include rollback
canonical_disclosures.post_fix_window: stored lagged60s online window; exact bounds not persisted; not assumed identical to descriptive post window
canonical_disclosures.time_to_recover_s: onset-relative end of first passing retrospective30s window scanned every10s, conditional on canonical recovery; not time since repair

restart_classification: Match ordered knob/value restart entries to attempted forward set_engine_config actions, then reverse previous-value rollback actions. Unmatched entries stay unclassified. Show all seconds separately.
